name: process_monitor
description: System process monitoring — list, inspect, and stop processes. Also shows CPU/RAM/disk usage.
author: JARVIS

tools.name: process_list
tools.description: List running processes sorted by CPU usage. Filter by name.

filter_name.description: Optional: only show processes containing this name

tools.name: process_info
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific process by PID.

tools.name: process_stop
tools.description: Stop a process by PID. Sends SIGTERM by default, SIGKILL if force=true.

tools.name: system_resources
tools.description: Get current CPU, RAM, disk, and GPU usage.

tools.name: network_connections
tools.description: List active network connections. Useful for detecting unexpected outbound connections.

filter_pid.description: Optional: only show connections for this PID
